findings.result: 2019 and Heisei30 remain historical references in all11reviewed locales. No conversion into current statistics was found.

24/20/9/4 percent remain tied to2019agricultural output value. Cultivated-area/weight shares remain distinct. Floriculture share within all agriculture remains distinct from cut-flower share within floriculture.
Yen /100million yen /1trillion yen distinction preserved across reviewed statistics-p3. No factor-of10/100error found.
2019weight table remains distinct from calorie-based indicator; texts do not treat them as equal-denominator percentages.
Satsuma/citrus and loquat remain evergreen, apple/grape/pear/peach/persimmon remain deciduous. Cold-region apple/warm-region satsuma tendency is not turned into exclusivity.

Environmental-control-based year-round same-kind production is distinguished from shifting production areas by climate/elevation in all11reviewed locales. No conflation with repeated same-place monocropping was found.

proposedCorrections.before: Citrus trees such as satsuma mandarin, and loquat, are classified as evergreen fruit trees. Learn the names together with their classification, rather than memorizing the names alone.
proposedCorrections.after: Citrus trees, including satsuma mandarin, are evergreen fruit trees. Loquat is also an evergreen fruit tree. Learn the names together with their classification, rather than memorizing the names alone.
proposedCorrections.sourceJa: ウンシュウミカンなどのかんきつ類や、ビワは常緑果樹として整理します。名前を覚えるだけでなく、分類と組み合わせて確認してください。
proposedCorrections.reason: Separate loquat explicitly from citrus examples; current punctuation is awkward and can be misread.

proposedCorrections.before: พืชตระกูลส้ม เช่น ส้มอุนชู และปี่แป่ อยู่ในกลุ่มไม้ผลไม่ผลัดใบ นอกจากจำชื่อแล้ว ให้ตรวจสอบประเภทควบคู่กันด้วย
proposedCorrections.after: พืชตระกูลส้ม เช่น ส้มอุนชู จัดอยู่ในกลุ่มไม้ผลไม่ผลัดใบ ส่วนต้นปี่แป่ก็เป็นไม้ผลไม่ผลัดใบเช่นกัน นอกจากจำชื่อแล้ว ให้ตรวจสอบประเภทควบคู่กันด้วย
proposedCorrections.sourceJa: ウンシュウミカンなどのかんきつ類や、ビワは常緑果樹として整理します。名前を覚えるだけでなく、分類と組み合わせて確認してください。
proposedCorrections.reason: Explicitly separates loquat from citrus so it is not read as another example of the citrus family.
